propositions.name: physical_facts_independent_of_consciousness
propositions.statement: physical facts exist with which we people space and which no consciousness sees directly
propositions.quote: we wish to put there physical facts, these I know not what with which we people space and which no consciousness sees directly

propositions.name: duration_not_directly_known
propositions.statement: we have not a direct intuition of the equality of two intervals of time
propositions.quote: We have not a direct intuition of the equality of two intervals of time

propositions.name: pendulum_beats_equal_by_definition
propositions.statement: physicists suppose by definition that all the beats of the pendulum are of equal duration
propositions.quote: they suppose by definition that all the beats of this pendulum are of equal duration

propositions.name: pendulum_affected_by_physical_conditions
propositions.statement: the temperature, the resistance of the air, and the barometric pressure make the pace of the pendulum vary
propositions.quote: the temperature, the resistance of the air, the barometric pressure, make the pace of the pendulum vary

propositions.name: unknown_causes_perturb_pendulum
propositions.statement: new causes, electric, magnetic or others, hitherto neglected, would introduce minute perturbations in the pendulum
propositions.quote: New causes, hitherto neglected, electric, magnetic or others, would introduce minute perturbations.

propositions.name: sidereal_day_as_constant_unit
propositions.statement: the sidereal day, the duration of the rotation of the earth, is the constant unit of time
propositions.quote: it is the sidereal day, that is, the duration of the rotation of the earth, which is the constant unit of time

propositions.name: earth_rotations_equal_duration_postulate
propositions.statement: it is supposed by a new definition that two complete rotations of the earth about its axis have the same duration
propositions.quote: It is supposed, by a new definition substituted for that based on the beats of the pendulum, that two complete rotations of the earth about its axis have the same duration.

propositions.name: tides_slow_earth_rotation
propositions.statement: the tides act as a check on our globe, and the rotation of the earth is becoming slower and slower
propositions.quote: the tides act as a check on our globe, and that the rotation of the earth is becoming slower and slower

propositions.name: moon_acceleration_explained_by_slow_earth
propositions.statement: the apparent acceleration of the motion of the moon would be explained because our watch, which is the earth, is going slow
propositions.quote: Thus would be explained the apparent acceleration of the motion of the moon, which would seem to be going more rapidly than theory permits because our watch, which is the earth, is going slow.

propositions.name: postulate_same_causes_same_time
propositions.statement: the duration of two identical phenomena is the same, or the same causes take the same time to produce the same effects
propositions.quote: the duration of two identical phenomena is the same; or, if you prefer, that the same causes take the same time to produce the same effects

propositions.name: postulate_could_be_contradicted
propositions.statement: experiment may some day contradict our postulate that the same causes take the same time to produce the same effects
propositions.quote: Is it impossible that experiment may some day contradict our postulate?

propositions.name: distant_phenomenon_at_another_place
propositions.statement: a phenomenon can happen at another place in the world very far away from the first
propositions.quote: At another place in the world very far away from the first, happens the phenomenon

propositions.name: multiplicity_of_causes
propositions.statement: in physical reality one cause does not produce a given effect, but a multitude of distinct causes contribute to produce it
propositions.quote: In physical reality one cause does not produce a given effect, but a multitude of distinct causes contribute to produce it, without our having any means of discriminating the part of each of them.

propositions.name: sirius_attraction_acts_on_pendulum
propositions.statement: in all rigor every attraction, even of Sirius, acts on the pendulum
propositions.quote: but in all rigor every attraction, even of Sirius, acts on the pendulum

propositions.name: vis_viva_conservation_of_energy
propositions.statement: the friction of the tides producing heat must destroy vis viva, which invokes the principle of vis viva, or of the conservation of energy
propositions.quote: the friction of the tides producing heat must destroy vis viva . They invoke therefore the principle of vis viva , or of the conservation of energy

propositions.name: newtons_law_and_moon_acceleration
propositions.statement: the secular acceleration of the moon, calculated according to Newton’s law, would be less than that deduced from observations unless the correction relative to the slowing down of the terrestrial rotation were made
propositions.quote: the secular acceleration of the moon, calculated according to Newton’s law, would be less than that deduced from observations unless the correction relative to the slowing down of the terrestrial rotation were made

propositions.name: newtons_law_approximate_truth
propositions.statement: Newton's law is an experimental truth, and as such it is only approximate
propositions.quote: Newton’s law is an experimental truth; as such it is only approximate

propositions.name: time_defined_for_simple_mechanics
propositions.statement: time should be so defined that the equations of mechanics may be as simple as possible
propositions.quote: Time should be so defined that the equations of mechanics may be as simple as possible.

propositions.name: no_measure_of_time_more_true
propositions.statement: there is not one way of measuring time more true than another, and that which is generally adopted is only more convenient
propositions.quote: there is not one way of measuring time more true than another; that which is generally adopted is only more convenient

propositions.name: starlight_needs_two_hundred_years
propositions.statement: at least two hundred years were necessary for the light from that star to reach our earth
propositions.quote: at least two hundred years were necessary for the light from that star to reach our earth

propositions.name: conflagration_before_discovery_of_america
propositions.statement: the conflagration happened before the discovery of America
propositions.quote: This conflagration therefore happened before the discovery of America. Well, when I say that;

propositions.name: anteriority_needs_convention
propositions.statement: affirmations that a phenomenon is anterior to another have by themselves no meaning and can have meaning only as the outcome of a convention
propositions.quote: all these affirmations have by themselves no meaning. They can have one only as the outcome of a convention.

propositions.name: cause_defines_anteriority
propositions.statement: when a phenomenon appears to us as the cause of another, we regard it as anterior, and it is by cause that we define time
propositions.quote: when a phenomenon appears to us as the cause of another, we regard it as anterior. It is therefore by cause that we define time

propositions.name: thunder_caused_by_electric_discharge
propositions.statement: hearing thunder leads us to conclude there has been an electric discharge, the physical phenomenon anterior to the auditory image perceived in consciousness, because it is its cause
propositions.quote: I hear thunder, and I conclude there has been an electric discharge; I do not hesitate to consider the physical phenomenon as anterior to the auditory image perceived in my consciousness, because I believe it is its cause

propositions.name: physical_phenomena_known_only_by_sensations
propositions.statement: we never know directly the physical phenomena; what we know are the sensations produced by them
propositions.quote: Doubtless, but take care; we never know directly the physical phenomena

propositions.name: thunder_sound_delayed_after_discharge
propositions.statement: we hear the sound of the thunder only some seconds after the electric discharge of the cloud
propositions.quote: We hear the sound of the thunder only some seconds after the electric discharge of the cloud.

propositions.name: distant_lightning_flash_can_be_earlier
propositions.statement: of two flashes of lightning, the one distant, the other near, the first can be anterior to the second even though the sound of the second comes to us before that of the first
propositions.quote: the one distant, the other near, can not the first be anterior to the second, even though the sound of the second comes to us before that of the first

propositions.name: universe_interchained_state_determines_phenomenon
propositions.statement: if all the parts of the universe are interchained, any phenomenon is not the effect of a single cause, but the resultant of causes infinitely numerous
propositions.quote: If all the parts of the universe are interchained in a certain measure, any one phenomenon will not be the effect of a single cause, but the resultant of causes infinitely numerous

propositions.name: three_bodies_determine_all_instants
propositions.statement: the positions and velocities of three bodies at a given instant suffice to determine their positions and velocities at the following instant, and consequently at any instant
propositions.quote: The positions and the velocities of three bodies at a given instant suffice to determine their positions and velocities at the following instant, and consequently at any instant.

propositions.name: jupiter_saturn_bound_by_laws
propositions.statement: the positions of Jupiter and Saturn at different instants are bound to one another by laws as precise as that of Newton, though more complicated
propositions.quote: by laws as precise as that of Newton, though more complicated

propositions.name: simultaneity_chosen_by_convenience
propositions.statement: there can only be reasons of convenience and simplicity for regarding one aggregate of positions as the cause of the other and for considering certain instants as simultaneous
propositions.quote: In answer there can only be reasons, very strong, it is true, of convenience and simplicity.

propositions.name: light_constant_velocity_postulate
propositions.statement: light has a constant velocity, and in particular its velocity is the same in all directions
propositions.quote: He has begun by supposing that light has a constant velocity, and in particular that its velocity is the same in all directions.

propositions.name: light_postulate_not_directly_verifiable
propositions.statement: the postulate could never be verified directly by experiment; it might be contradicted by it if the results of different measurements were not concordant
propositions.quote: This postulate could never be verified directly by experiment; it might be contradicted by it if the results of different measurements were not concordant.

propositions.name: roemer_measured_light_velocity
propositions.statement: Roemer used eclipses of the satellites of Jupiter, and sought how much the event fell behind its prediction, to measure the velocity of light
propositions.quote: Roemer used eclipses of the satellites of Jupiter, and sought how much the event fell behind its prediction

propositions.name: light_velocity_chosen_for_simplicity
propositions.statement: a value for the velocity of light is adopted such that the astronomic laws compatible with this value may be as simple as possible
propositions.quote: a value is adopted, such that the astronomic laws compatible with this value may be as simple as possible

propositions.name: longitude_via_carried_chronometer
propositions.statement: navigators determine longitude by carrying a chronometer set for Paris
propositions.quote: How do they accomplish it? They carry a chronometer set for Paris.

propositions.name: moon_eclipse_not_simultaneous_everywhere
propositions.statement: an eclipse of the moon is not perceived simultaneously from all points of the earth because the propagation of light is not instantaneous
propositions.quote: That is not altogether true, since the propagation of light is not instantaneous; if absolute exactitude were desired, there would be a correction to make according to a complicated rule.

propositions.name: telegraph_signal_after_sending
propositions.statement: the reception of the signal at Berlin is after the sending of this same signal from Paris
propositions.quote: the reception of the signal at Berlin, for instance, is after the sending of this same signal from Paris

propositions.name: rules_not_imposed_but_convenient
propositions.statement: these rules are not imposed upon us and we might amuse ourselves in inventing others, but they could not be cast aside without greatly complicating the laws of physics, mechanics and astronomy
propositions.quote: These rules are not imposed upon us and we might amuse ourselves in inventing others; but they could not be cast aside without greatly complicating the enunciation of the laws of physics, mechanics and astronomy.

propositions.name: simultaneity_defined_for_simple_laws
propositions.statement: the simultaneity of two events, the order of their succession, and the equality of two durations are to be so defined that the enunciation of the natural laws may be as simple as possible
propositions.quote: The simultaneity of two events, or the order of their succession, the equality of two durations, are to be so defined that the enunciation of the natural laws may be as simple as possible.
